description.p: Masterpiece is an open-source player for sampled pipe organs. It opens sample sets in the Hauptwerk and GrandOrgue formats, shows the organ's console, and plays it from a MIDI keyboard or console, with the stops, couplers, swell boxes, tremulants and wind of the real instrument.

ul.li: Opens organs in the Hauptwerk and GrandOrgue formats, from their folders or straight from their archives
Draws the organ's own console, with every stop, piston and swell shoe working
Maps any MIDI console: several messages per stop, lamps and motorised faders, keyboard shortcuts
Combinations, a registration sequencer and a recorder
Loads large organs within a memory limit you set, and streams release tails from disk

screenshot.caption: The console of an organ, ready to play

description.p: An experimental vectorized audio engine, off by default; large organs load much faster; large solid RAR archives load completely.
